result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For most small support teams, I'd recommend **Freshdesk** as the best all-round help desk software.

It offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation, reporting and room to grow without the complexity of an enterprise platform.

However, the best choice depends on how your team handles customer support.

## My top 5 help desk recommendations

![Top Free Customer Service Software in 2026 - Freshworks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5E2r2AcnIDT8zxLIiBADz7hJ8MoDzh_ulTvFG_8pkN5lnYNePkWR9wfYBeU0JTCyXfieSrXS13FyL6gvZXQBafGdl1pgWMvhtSXXYb4lkixcjz35s8nCMtgLbBtCtMUBB-S50yzPR2WJ7cFRTyIsXX65wwHU3s7ubgQYwXkEN4rZ-JrQ3s4HUtiKIs0TK67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

- Excellent ticket management and automation.
- Shared inbox, knowledge base and reporting.
- Good balance of features and price.
- Indicative starting price: \$19/agent/month.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

- Very easy for a small team to adopt.
- Excellent shared email inbox.
- Customer-focused communication.
- Free plan for up to five users; paid Standard from \$25/user/month annually.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable ticket management.
- Strong workflow automation.
- Excellent if you already use Zoho CRM.
- Free edition for up to three agents.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

- Excellent advanced ticketing and workflows.
- Strong reporting and integrations.
- Better suited to growing or more complex teams.
- Can become expensive as you add features.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.co.uk/)

---

![Intercom rolls out new chatbot builder to automate customer engagement - SiliconANGLE](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jzeE4MaLeS0tyXfA5CHfvNBP6jl4TvlhhzLYUgiNMPVFQfNWEuknq1JqzSkb0wpi75ZBMytqr1FJMjCh6-VorsadNfIpsniqNxn3zFv08nj9wtRTEN6mxE6i6NF_hhN_gzXVNZiT8G8narT6eQ3KIsRX9ApsgEPew7jagwtBRXvHIv_F56HfHr1OZnLwQ_Gw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

- Excellent live chat and in-app messaging.
- Strong AI-powered customer support.
- Good for SaaS and digital businesses.
- AI resolution charges can add to costs.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

These are indicative starting prices, not directly equivalent plans. Check the current UK pricing, VAT and any AI usage charges before committing. ## Which would I actually choose?

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 2–10 support agents | Freshdesk |
| Small team, mainly email | Help Scout |
| Very limited budget | Zoho Desk |
| Growing, multi-channel operation | Zendesk |
| SaaS business with lots of live chat | Intercom |


## Three questions to narrow it down

I'd like to find the best option based on your actual support operation rather than just recommend the most popular product.

1\. **How many people are on your support team?**

- 1–3
- 4–10
- 11–20
- 20+

2\. **What channels do you support?**

- Email
- Live chat
- Telephone
- WhatsApp
- Social media
- A combination

3\. **What's most important?**

- Keeping costs low
- Easy-to-use ticket management
- Automation and AI
- Reporting and team performance
- All-round functionality

With those answers, I can narrow this down to the **best three platforms**, compare their actual costs and explain which I'd choose for your team.
